apis.name: AstroBin
apis.why_notable: Astrophotography image database with platesolving metadata; popular among amateur astronomy developers.

apis.name: ESA Gaia Archive TAP
apis.why_notable: Billion-star catalog via Table Access Protocol; core reference for stellar positions and parallaxes.

apis.name: ESA Sky API
apis.why_notable: Multi-mission sky survey imagery and catalog overlay access from ESA missions.

apis.name: Exoplanet Archive TAP
apis.why_notable: NASA's authoritative confirmed/candidate exoplanet tables with TAP and API interfaces.

apis.name: Horizons System API
apis.why_notable: JPL ephemerides for solar-system bodies; industry standard for trajectories and positions.

apis.name: Minor Planet Center API
apis.why_notable: IAU official near-Earth and minor planet orbits, observations, and designations.

apis.name: NASA APOD API
apis.why_notable: Astronomy Picture of the Day endpoint; entry point on NASA's shared API portal.

apis.name: NASA DONKI
apis.why_notable: Space-weather events (CMEs, flares, SEPs) from the Space Weather Database Of Notifications.

apis.name: NASA EPIC
apis.why_notable: Near-real-time full-disk Earth images from DSCOVR at L1; unique public Earth-from-space feed.

apis.name: NASA NeoWs
apis.why_notable: Near-Earth Object Web Service: asteroid close approaches, orbital data, browse by date.

apis.name: NCBI E-utilities
apis.why_notable: Programmatic access to PubMed, GenBank, and other NCBI databases; biology search backbone.
